name: HR WORKS
description: Access HR WORKS, the German HR/payroll platform: employees, absences, sick leaves, remote work (home office), working times, time accounts, wage payments, personnel files, projects, applicants, organization units, holidays and cost centers via the v2 REST API.
instructions:
This connector uses the HR WORKS v2 REST API (https://developers.hrworks.de).

**Authentication: automatic token refresh**: HR WORKS issues short-lived tokens (~15 minutes). This connector uses the `LOGIN_TOKEN` flow: it POSTs `{accessKey, secretAccessKey}` to `/v2/authentication`, reads the returned `token`, sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and refreshes it automatically before expiry (and re-logs-in on a 401). You never handle tokens manually.

**Setup**: create an API key pair in HR WORKS (Administration → API) and set:
- `HRWORKS_ACCESS_KEY` = your access key
- `HRWORKS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` = your secret access key

**Sandbox**: HR WORKS provides a demo environment at `https://api.demo-hrworks.de`. To test against it, change the connector's Base URL and the `loginUrl` in the auth config to the demo host.

**Identifiers**: most person-related endpoints accept either the HR WORKS personnel number or the HR WORKS username. Use the optional `personIdentifierType` / `usePersonnelNumbers` parameters when the identifier you have on hand is not the default.

**Date intervals**: most listing endpoints (absences, sick leaves, working times, remote work) require ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` `beginDate`/`endDate`; the maximum span is one year (or 31 days if `interval=days`). Working times are stricter: at most 31 days touching at most two calendar months per call.

**Pagination**: page size is 50; the API returns a `Link` header with next/prev URLs. Pass `page` to step through results.

**Rate limit**: HR WORKS imposes per-tenant rate limits; see their developer portal for details.

**Clock status, onboarding and deleting working times**: `hrworks_get_working_time_status` tells whether a person is clocked in right now. `hrworks_list_onboarding_documents` and `hrworks_get_onboarding_document` read the onboarding documents of new employees, which hold private data (bank account, social security number): share only what the user needs. `hrworks_delete_working_times` deletes working times by their number (`<personnel number>_<start as Unix seconds>`); it is installed switched off, and like the other working-time writes it answers with a job id for `hrworks_get_working_times_job`.

tools.name: hrworks_health_check
tools.description: Check whether the HR WORKS API is reachable. Returns 200 OK with no body. Useful for connector validation; does not require authentication.

tools.name: hrworks_list_organization_units
tools.description: List all active organization units (Organisationseinheiten) of the company with their uuid, number and name.

tools.name: hrworks_get_organization_unit
tools.description: Return the data of a specific organization unit. Pass the unit's uuid (preferred) or its number (deprecated).

uuid.description: The uuid (preferred) or number of the organization unit.

tools.name: hrworks_list_present_persons
tools.description: List all persons currently 'in the office' for a given organization unit. Accounts for vacations, trips, sicknesses and other absences (forenoon/afternoon).

number.description: Number/ID of the organization unit to inspect.

tools.name: hrworks_list_permanent_establishments
tools.description: List all permanent establishments (Betriebsstätten) of the company with id and name.

tools.name: hrworks_list_holidays
tools.description: List company holidays for a given year and (optionally) country. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g. DEU, AUT, CHE).

countryCodes.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes to filter by (e.g. ['DEU']).

permanentEstablishments.description: Optional list of permanent establishment IDs.

tools.name: hrworks_list_persons
tools.description: List all persons (employees) in the company. By default only active employees are returned. Optionally filter by organization unit.

organizationUnits.description: Filter by one or more organization unit identifiers.

onlyActive.description: If false, also returns persons that have left the company (default: true).

onlyActiveOrganizationUnits.description: If false, also returns persons assigned to deactivated org units (default: true).

identifierType.description: Type of identifier in organizationUnits ('number' or 'uuid'). Default 'number'.

tools.name: hrworks_get_person
tools.description: Return the base data of a specific person (employee). The personIdentifier defaults to the personnel number; pass personIdentifierType='username' or 'personId' to use a different identifier.

personIdentifier.description: Personnel number (default), HR WORKS username or personId of the person.

tools.name: hrworks_list_persons_master_data
tools.description: Return the current master data (full personal data, contract details, addresses, bank info, etc.) for one or more persons. Page size is 50.

persons.description: List of person identifiers to fetch. If omitted, returns master data for all active persons.

onlyActive.description: If false, also returns persons that have left the company (default: true).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_get_persons_today
tools.description: Return day-related objects (working hours, attendance, absences) for the current day for one or more persons.

persons.description: List of person identifiers. If omitted, returns data for all active persons.

onlyActive.description: If false, also returns persons that have left the company (default: true).

includeData.description: Optional list of data sources to include (e.g. workingTimes, absences). Target working hours and holidays are always included.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_get_leave_account
tools.description: Return the leave account (vacation balance) of a single person up to a reference date. The interval starts at January 1st of the reference year.

personnelNumber.description: HR WORKS personnel number of the person.

referenceDate.description: Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, defaults to today.

tools.name: hrworks_list_absences
tools.description: List absences (vacation, parental leave, etc.) for one or more persons over a date interval. Required: beginDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, max 1-year span).

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames (or personnel numbers if usePersonnelNumbers=true).

types.description: Optional absence type keys to filter by (see hrworks_list_absence_types).

count.description: If true, return cumulated working-day counts per absence type instead of details.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, treat 'persons' values as personnel numbers (default: false → usernames).

onlyActive.description: If false, includes persons who have left the company.

statusFilter.description: Optional list of absence statuses to filter by (e.g. APPROVED, PENDING).

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_list_absence_types
tools.description: List all absence types (vacation, parental leave, special leave, etc.) configured for the customer account, with their keys for use as filter values.

onlyActive.description: If true, only currently active absence types are returned.

tools.name: hrworks_list_vacation_types
tools.description: List vacation types defined for the customer account (subset of absence types focused on vacation/leave).

tools.name: hrworks_list_sick_leaves
tools.description: List sick leaves (Krankheitstage) for one or more persons over a date interval. Required: beginDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, max 1-year span).

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames (or personnel numbers if usePersonnelNumbers=true).

types.description: Optional sick leave type keys to filter by.

count.description: If true, return cumulated working-day counts per type instead of details.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, treat 'persons' values as personnel numbers.

onlyActive.description: If false, includes persons who have left the company.

statusFilter.description: Optional list of sick leave statuses to filter by.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_list_sick_leave_types
tools.description: List all sick leave types configured for the customer account with their keys (used as filter values for hrworks_list_sick_leaves).

tools.name: hrworks_list_remote_work
tools.description: List remote work / home office records for one or more persons over a date interval. Required: beginDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, max 1-year span).

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames (or personnel numbers if usePersonnelNumbers=true).

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, treat 'persons' values as personnel numbers.

onlyActive.description: If false, includes persons who have left the company.

statusFilter.description: Optional list of statuses to filter by.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_list_working_times
tools.description: List logged working times (time tracking) for one or more persons over a date interval. Required: beginDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD); HR WORKS allows at most 31 days touching at most two calendar months per call, so ask month by month. Only persons with a time recording regulation in the interval are returned.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames (or personnel numbers if usePersonnelNumbers=true).

types.description: Optional working time types to filter by (see hrworks_list_time_recording_regulations).

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, treat 'persons' values as personnel numbers.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_list_time_recording_regulations
tools.description: List all time-recording regulations configured for the customer (defines which working time types are allowed per regulation).

tools.name: hrworks_list_projects
tools.description: List the time-tracking projects of the company, e.g. to find the project id behind a working time.

tools.name: hrworks_get_project
tools.description: Return the data of one time-tracking project by its id from hrworks_list_projects.

tools.name: hrworks_list_project_customers
tools.description: List the customers that time-tracking projects are booked for (project customers).

tools.name: hrworks_list_job_applications
tools.description: List job applications. Optionally filter by post id and/or status.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

posts.description: Optional list of post ids to filter by.

statusFilter.description: Optional list of application status identifiers to filter by.

tools.name: hrworks_list_posts
tools.description: List the recruiting posts (job postings) of the company; inactive ones on request.

onlyActive.description: If false, also returns inactive posts (default: true).

tools.name: hrworks_get_post
tools.description: Return the data of one recruiting post (job posting) by its uuid from hrworks_list_posts.

uuid.description: The uuid (preferred) or id of the post.

tools.name: hrworks_list_applicants
tools.description: List applicants (only those with at least one job application). Optionally filter by status.

statusFilter.description: Optional list of application statuses to filter by.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_get_applicant
tools.description: Return data of a specific applicant by uuid. The uuid does not change when the applicant is converted to an employee.

tools.name: hrworks_list_cost_centers
tools.description: List all cost centers (Kostenstellen) of the company with their number/id and name.

tools.name: hrworks_list_cost_objectives
tools.description: List all cost objectives (Kostenträger) of the company with their number and name.

tools.name: hrworks_list_wage_salary_types
tools.description: List all wage/salary types defined for the customer account (used in payroll exports).

tools.name: hrworks_list_travel_expense_reports
tools.description: List travel expense reports (Reisekostenabrechnungen) in a date interval, optionally for some people. Required: beginDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, treat 'persons' values as personnel numbers.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (page size 50).

tools.name: hrworks_list_time_accounts
tools.description: Return the time accounts (Arbeitszeitkonto: target hours, worked hours, overtime balance) of people for one or more months. Defaults to the current month for everyone active. Read-only.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true. Omit for everyone.

monthYears.description: Months to return as YYYY-MM, e.g. ["2026-09","2026-10"]. Default: the current month.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, the values in persons are personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

onlyActive.description: Default true. Set false to include people who have left the company. Ignored when persons is given.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (50 per page). The response Link header says whether there are more.

tools.name: hrworks_list_leave_accounts
tools.description: Return the leave accounts (vacation entitlement, approved, requested, planned and expiring days) of several people at once, up to a reference date. For one person, hrworks_get_leave_account is enough. Read-only.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true. Omit for everyone.

referenceDate.description: Reference date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today; the account runs from January 1st of that year.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, the values in persons are personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

onlyActive.description: Default true. Set false to include people who have left the company. Ignored when persons is given.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (50 per page). The response Link header says whether there are more.

tools.name: hrworks_get_available_working_hours
tools.description: Return the working hours people are available in a date interval (target hours minus absences), summed or split by day, week or month. Useful for capacity planning. Read-only.

beginDate.description: Start of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD. The interval may span at most one year.

endDate.description: End of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD.

persons.description: Optional identifiers of the people; personIdentifierType says what they are (default personId). Omit for everyone.

personIdentifierType.description: What the values in persons are. Default personId.

interval.description: Optional split of the interval: days (then at most 31 days), weeks or months.

onlyActive.description: Default true. Set false to include people who have left the company. Ignored when persons is given.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (150 per page).

tools.name: hrworks_get_absences_accumulated
tools.description: Return the number of working days of absence per absence type (vacation, special leave, ...) for each person in a date interval, instead of the single absences. Read-only.

beginDate.description: Start of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD. The interval may span at most one year.

endDate.description: End of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true. Omit for everyone.

types.description: Optional type keys to filter by.

statusFilter.description: Optional statuses to count, e.g. approved, requested.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, the values in persons are personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

interval.description: Optional split of the interval: days (then at most 31 days), weeks or months.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (50 per page). The response Link header says whether there are more.

tools.name: hrworks_get_sick_leaves_accumulated
tools.description: Return the number of working days of sick leave per sick leave type for each person in a date interval. Health data: only share it with people allowed to see it. Read-only.

beginDate.description: Start of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD. The interval may span at most one year.

endDate.description: End of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true. Omit for everyone.

types.description: Optional type keys to filter by.

statusFilter.description: Optional statuses to count, e.g. approved, requested.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, the values in persons are personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

interval.description: Optional split of the interval: days (then at most 31 days), weeks or months.

onlyActive.description: Default true. Set false to include people who have left the company. Ignored when persons is given.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (50 per page). The response Link header says whether there are more.

tools.name: hrworks_get_remote_work_accumulated
tools.description: Return the number of remote work (home office) days for each person in a date interval. Read-only.

beginDate.description: Start of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD. The interval may span at most one year.

endDate.description: End of the date interval, YYYY-MM-DD.

persons.description: Optional list of HR WORKS usernames, or personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true. Omit for everyone.

statusFilter.description: Optional statuses to count, e.g. approved, requested.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: If true, the values in persons are personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

interval.description: Optional split of the interval: days (then at most 31 days), weeks or months.

onlyActive.description: Default true. Set false to include people who have left the company. Ignored when persons is given.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1 (50 per page). The response Link header says whether there are more.

tools.name: hrworks_get_person_master_data
tools.description: Return the current master data of one person: name, contact data, address, organization unit, employment, contract and similar fields. For many people at once use hrworks_list_persons_master_data. Read-only.

personIdentifier.description: The person, by default as personnel number.

tools.name: hrworks_list_personnel_file_entries
tools.description: List the entries of one person's digital personnel file (Personalakte), optionally filtered by category, creation date, attached documents or wage relevance. Personnel file content is confidential. Read-only.

personIdentifier.description: The person, by default as personnel number.

category.description: Optional key of a personnel file category.

createdAfter.description: Only entries created on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

createdBefore.description: Only entries created on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

hasDocuments.description: Only entries with (true) or without (false) attached PDF documents.

isWageRelevant.description: Only entries that are (true) or are not (false) relevant for payroll.

tools.name: hrworks_list_person_wage_payments
tools.description: List the wage payments (Lohnzahlungen: wage type, amount, period) recorded for one person. The person is given by UUID: hrworks_get_person and hrworks_list_persons_master_data return it. Payroll data is confidential. Read-only.

tools.name: hrworks_list_wage_payments
tools.description: List wage payments across all people, optionally only for one wage type (see hrworks_list_wage_salary_types). Payroll data is confidential. Read-only.

wageTypeNumber.description: Optional number of the wage type to filter by.

tools.name: hrworks_create_working_times
tools.description: Record working times or breaks for one or more people. HR WORKS processes the request in the background and answers with a job id: check the result with hrworks_get_working_times_job. Changes time tracking data, so confirm the people, dates and times with the user before calling.

beginDateAndTime.description: Start as ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-12T06:10:00Z.

endDateAndTime.description: End as ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-12T16:15:00Z.

deleteOverlappingWorkingTimes.description: If true, existing working times that overlap the new ones are deleted. Default false. Ask the user before setting it.

tools.name: hrworks_update_working_times
tools.description: Change working times that already exist in HR WORKS, with the same item format as hrworks_create_working_times. Processed in the background; check the job with hrworks_get_working_times_job. Confirm the changes with the user before calling.

data.description: The working times to change, in the format of hrworks_create_working_times.

deleteOverlappingWorkingTimes.description: If true, other working times that overlap the changed ones are deleted. Default false. Ask the user before setting it.

tools.name: hrworks_get_working_times_job
tools.description: Return the status and result of a create, update or delete of working times, by the job id those tools returned. Read-only.

jobId.description: Job id returned by hrworks_create_working_times, hrworks_update_working_times or hrworks_delete_working_times.

tools.name: hrworks_get_working_time_status
tools.description: Return whether a person is clocked in right now and, if so, the running working time: start, type (working time, business errand, doctor's appointment...), project, comment and kiosk. Read-only.

personIdentifier.description: Personnel number of the person (default), or the identifier named in personIdentifierType.

personIdentifierType.description: Type of personIdentifier. Leave out for the company's default identifier for working times (usually the personnel number).

tools.name: hrworks_list_onboarding_documents
tools.description: List the onboarding documents (Onboarding-Dokumente) of new employees: name, join date, organization unit, superior, status and the personal data the new employee entered. Contains private data such as address, bank account and social security number. Filter by status or organization unit. Read-only.

statusFilter.description: Only documents in these states: created (sent to the new employee), editingFinished (filled in, waiting for HR) or activated (the person was created from it).

organizationUnits.description: Only documents of people assigned to these organization units (numbers from hrworks_list_organization_units).

tools.name: hrworks_get_onboarding_document
tools.description: Return one onboarding document by id, with all the data the new employee entered (address, bank account, tax and social security data, emergency contact) and its status. Read-only.

tools.name: hrworks_delete_working_times
tools.description: Delete recorded working times. Each one is named by its number: the personnel number, an underscore and the start as Unix time in seconds (e.g. 1_1683093600), the `id` that hrworks_list_working_times returns. Deleted times are gone from time tracking and the time accounts change. HR WORKS processes the request in the background and answers with a job id: check the result with hrworks_get_working_times_job. List the times to delete to the user and confirm before calling. Installed switched off.

numbers.description: Working time numbers to delete, e.g. ["1_1683093600"].
